items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal went with a rise about 3.2 mg/dL smaller. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain: 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones. Try to start dinner before 8 pm as sugar rose about 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.
